purpose: Locate signed-error and raw squared-error changes across quantity/history cells and compare with train-only gradient attribution at existing Intermittent checkpoints.

source.identity_authority: content-addressed 70-file frozen import closure, including originally uncommitted code

server.runtime_policy: Exact original strict-runtime identity required; no package/runtime/source adjustment or fallback to another server.

statistics.initialization_policy: use original frozen B mu/std after verifying recalculation; no refitted replacement

source.identity_authority: content-addressed import closure; includes uncommitted implementation

primary.meaning: Each arm raw-RMSE selected checkpoint; different training steps; selection uses same validation population.

last120.meaning: Only this scope is a common-step comparison.

cells.quantity_definition: Untransformed next-event target quantity, finite and nonnegative.
cells.history_definition: Number of valid events in original padded sample minus one target event; no batch subset re-padding.
cells.sparse_cell_policy: Report observed counts; no adaptive oversampling, merging, or significance claim.

validation.loader: Frozen validation loader, original sample order, no shuffle, no dropped batch.

pair_contributions.RMSE_rule: Compute RMSE from total SSE/N. Do not label delta_SSE/N as additive RMSE contribution.
pair_contributions.share_rule: Always show signed changes and positive/negative sums; net shares null if total delta is zero. Offsetting shares are not causal percentages.

train_probe.selection: Reuse original calibration CPU torch.randperm(train_count, generator seed1042)[:8192] in unsorted selected order; frozen collate; no shuffle/drop_last/workers.
train_probe.index_hash_definition: Frozen canonical_state_dict_sha256({indices: CPU int64 indices tensor}); not raw integer bytes.
train_probe.batch_hash_definition: SHA256 concatenated ASCII hex canonical_state_dict_sha256({dts,mask,quantities}) for each original pre-right-padding batch in selection order.
train_probe.dropout_seed_rule: 9042 + zero_based_batch_index, identical for all six states; reset Python, NumPy, CPU and CUDA RNG immediately before the single forward.
train_probe.mode_semantics: New controlled train-mode probe at saved weights, not historical training trajectory replay; validation remains eval-mode.
train_probe.loss_vector_requirement: Frozen mixed_joint_causal_batch_objective outputs from the original whole batch; no per-cell subset forwards.
train_probe.empty_cell_gradient: Zero vector in the same parameter order; skip redundant autograd call.
train_probe.gradient_method: autograd.grad over the same graph, allow_unused=True, materialize unused as zero; never populate .grad or instantiate an optimizer.
train_probe.B_raw_component: Measure raw loss derivative for diagnostic comparison but its actual joint coefficient stays alpha=0.

parameter_partitions.encoder: All remaining active parameters, including memory; not a memory-only measurement

train_probe.cell_projection: dot(g_joint_cell, g_joint_all) / squared_norm(g_joint_all), null when denominator is zero; sum over cells is one when defined.
train_probe.zero_norm_policy: For every cell and parameter group, cosine is null if either vector norm is zero; projection is null if its denominator is zero, even for nonempty cells. B actual alpha-weighted raw contribution remains a zero vector.
additional_measurements: Per-cell per-task loss sums and gradient norms
Time/quantity and log/raw dot products and cosines
Raw component projection onto actual joint gradient
Global preclip norm and common clip coefficient
Cell contributions before/after common global clipping
train_probe.cell_gradient_aggregation: Sum cell vectors, not cell norms; whole sample mean is sum_b(n_b/N_train_probe * gradient_b).
train_probe.batch_summary_aggregation: Preserve per-batch count, dot products, squared norms, clip factors and cell counts. Do not average normalized projections and call it a whole-sample projection.

energy_aggregation.calibration_comparison: Initial calibration head matching concerns mean_batch_squared_norm over its equal-size batches, not squared_norm_of_mean_gradient. Store and label these separately.

train_probe.gradient_storage: Stream batch summaries and running vector sums; do not persist per-example gradient vectors or retain more than one batch graph.
train_probe.gradient_audit: For every loss component, verify sum of 15 cell gradients equals independently computed full-batch gradient; also verify composed joint versus actual objective gradient.

clipping.application: Multiply every task/cell contribution by the SAME full-batch k_b; never clip cells independently.
clipping.postclip_sample_mean: sum_b(n_b/N_train_probe * k_b * g_cell_b), not clip(sum_b n_b/N * g_cell_b).
clipping.meaning: Checkpoint probe gradient entering an optimizer hypothetically; no AdamW step or effective learning-rate claim.

immutability: Checkpoint bytes rehashed before and after each state; CPU weights-only deserialization with explicit schema-specific safe globals, never unrestricted fallback.
Verify tensor state, selector, epoch, step, condition and original arm contract against frozen evidence before use.
Use fresh model per state; hash all state_dict tensors before/after; preserve module modes, requires_grad and existing gradients.
Snapshot/restore Python, NumPy, CPU Torch and all CUDA RNG states in finally.
Explicitly verify contextual_mem_size==0, context update disabled and every layer.attn._ctx_mem is None before/after; state_dict hash alone is insufficient.
No optimizer construction, update, training resume, checkpoint save, source mutation, new selectors, or calibration refit.

validation_gates.gradient_gate_rule: Pass if absolute L2 residual <=1e-6 OR relative residual <=1e-4; zero reference requires absolute bound.
validation_gates.nonfinite_values: Stop on any NaN/Inf in predictions, losses, gradients or nonempty aggregates.
validation_gates.failure_action: Stop the owned diagnostic process, preserve partial evidence and mark affected comparisons unverified; no adaptive tolerances or automatic rerun.

limits.timing_interpretation: New diagnostic-specific stop limits proposed for approval, not an ETA or an extension of the completed training budget.
limits.timer_start: One monotonic parent-supervised deadline starts before any remote preflight or model/data load; all phases share it.
limits.other_jobs: Require an idle GPU at launch; never terminate unrelated jobs. If unavailable, record external wait and do not start.

interpretation.primary_question: Does 46<q<=187 contribute positively to delta SSE/MSE and show a different signed-error pattern?
interpretation.gradient_question: On the fixed train sample, which quantity/history cells project strongly onto the raw component and clipped joint direction?
interpretation.split_link: Relate train and validation CELL patterns descriptively, never join their target rows or claim the same samples caused both effects.
interpretation.causality: Matching cell-level patterns is a supported mechanism hypothesis, not proof that clipping caused validation harm. No clipping intervention occurs.
interpretation.absence_of_evidence: Sparse/empty train cells or no matching pattern leave the mechanism unresolved; no post-result resampling.
interpretation.candidate_decision: B remains the control. This diagnostic neither retrains a candidate nor establishes Backbone defects or benchmark superiority.
interpretation.time_metric: Legacy clamped time loss with intercept cap300; not normalized Time NLL.
interpretation.held_out: Locked. Single seed validation is not an independent generalization test.

implementation_requirements: New bounded adapter for six mixed-objective states; the existing four-condition CLI cannot be used unchanged.
Reuse verified payload loader, frozen input factory, mixed objective and paired-error helpers through an isolated import closure.
Add same-forward 15-cell gradient decomposition with full-batch normalization and common global clipping.

CPU synthetic checks: uneven/empty cells, boundary equality, partial batches, signed error and SSE conservation, gradient cancellation/projections, mixed objective coefficients, dropout/RNG/state/context preservation, hard limits and reject-unapproved entrypoint.
Freeze adapter and helper file checksums in a separate execution binding referencing this immutable measurement contract; verify full original source closure remains unchanged.
Only after implementation/review/CPU checks are complete, obtain separate approval for the concrete 5090 diagnostic and run strict runtime/identity gates within the approved limits.
output_policy: Small JSON/JSONL evidence and text in the current session only; no web application, HTML, Markdown report, Notion, commit or push.
